fullTextZH: 你好，今天我要说说为什么
fullTextEN: Hello, today I want to talk about why

fullTextZH: 我从中国来到澳大利亚。
fullTextEN: I came to Australia from China.
In 2017, I was teaching Chinese in Beijing.

fullTextZH: 我给我的一个好朋友上课。
fullTextEN: I taught a class to a good friend of mine.
One day, he asked me: 'Hey,'
Hello, how are you?'

fullTextZH: 然后我很认真地说：“我不好。”
fullTextEN: Then I seriously said: 'I'm not well.'
He said: 'Why?'
I said: 'Because I broke up,
I'm very sad.'
Then he said: 'Oh,'
Then let's not have class,
we can go drink.'
I said: 'No, no,
no drinking,
we can have class.'
So we didn't go drinking.

fullTextZH: 但是他问我：“为什么你分手？”
fullTextEN: But he asked me: 'Why did you break up?'
I said: 'Because I don't want to get married,
marriage without kids.'
He said, 'Then what do you want?'

fullTextZH: 我说：“嗯，我要去看看世界。”
fullTextEN: I said, 'Hmm, I want to go see the world.'

fullTextZH: 然后他说：“那你什么时候去看世界呢？”
fullTextEN: Then he said, 'So when are you going to see the world?'

fullTextZH: 我想，对，我常常说我要去看看世界，
fullTextEN: I thought, yes, I often say I want to go see the world,

fullTextZH: 可是为什么我什么都不做？
fullTextEN: but why do I do nothing?
So I decided, 'Okay,'
I will start preparing,
I want to go see the world.'

fullTextZH: 所以那天下课，我开始查，
fullTextEN: So that day after class, I started searching,

fullTextZH: 如果没有钱，怎么去外国。
fullTextEN: how to go abroad without money.
So I searched,
searched,

fullTextZH: 然后我发现，我可以去两个国家：
fullTextEN: then I found out I could go to two countries:
One is Australia,
one is New Zealand.

fullTextZH: 只有澳大利亚和新西兰
fullTextEN: Only Australia and New Zealand
offer Chinese people a 'working holiday visa,'

fullTextZH: 中文我们叫“打工度假签证”。
fullTextEN: In Chinese, we call it a 'working holiday visa.'

fullTextZH: 我觉得澳大利亚、新西兰都很好，
fullTextEN: I think both Australia and New Zealand are great,
I want to go to both.
But this visa is very difficult,
because every year

fullTextZH: 澳大利亚给中国人5,000个名额，
fullTextEN: Australia gives 5,000 spots to Chinese people,

fullTextZH: 可是新西兰给中国人1,000个名额，
fullTextEN: but New Zealand gives 1,000 spots to Chinese people,
so you have to compete for it.

fullTextZH: 不是所有的时间你都可以抢，
fullTextEN: You can't compete all the time,
You have to wait,
You have to wait a bit.

fullTextZH: 澳大利亚和新西兰的政府说好：
fullTextEN: The governments of Australia and New Zealand agreed:
"We will open these spots,
then you can compete."
So I wait,

fullTextZH: 然后可以抢的时候，我去抢。
fullTextEN: and then when I can compete, I go compete.
Maybe I competed three times,

fullTextZH: 第三次我觉得我一定要抢到这个名额。
fullTextEN: The third time I felt I must get this spot.
So I went to an internet cafe,

fullTextZH: 然后我从早上9点到下午2点左右，我
fullTextEN: then from 9 AM to around 2 PM, I
competed for five hours.

fullTextZH: 终于，我抢到了这个名额！
fullTextEN: Finally, I got this spot!
After getting this spot,
You need to go prepare a lot of things,

fullTextZH: 比如说，你要准备你的英语，
fullTextEN: For example, you need to prepare your English,
You need to prepare a little money,

fullTextZH: 然后你要准备很多很多文件。
fullTextEN: Then you need to prepare many, many documents.

fullTextZH: 所以我准备了所有的东西，
fullTextEN: So I prepared everything,
Finally, in September 2017,
I got this visa.

fullTextZH: 可是我没有马上去澳大利亚，
fullTextEN: But I didn't go to Australia immediately,
Because I still wanted to do one thing,

fullTextZH: 就是我要坐火车去俄罗斯。
fullTextEN: Which is I wanted to take a train to Russia.
In China,

fullTextZH: 你可以从北京坐6天的火车去俄罗斯。
fullTextEN: You can take a 6-day train from Beijing to Russia.

fullTextZH: 所以我坐了火车去俄罗斯，
fullTextEN: So I took a train to Russia,
But in Russia,
My wallet was stolen,
I lost all my money!
But I wasn't very sad,

fullTextZH: 因为我不知道我的钱包有多少钱。
fullTextEN: Because I didn't know how much money was in my wallet.

fullTextZH: 然后我从俄罗斯飞回中国，
fullTextEN: Then I flew back to China from Russia,
Then I went to Australia again.
In December 2017,
I arrived in Sydney, Australia.
My first feeling was: "Hmm,
the weather is really nice."
Then,

fullTextZH: 我看到很多很多人穿背心和拖鞋。
fullTextEN: I saw many people wearing vests and slippers.
So I was very happy,

fullTextZH: 嗯，我觉得我来到了一个对的国家，
fullTextEN: Hmm, I felt I came to the right country,

fullTextZH: 因为我最喜欢穿背心和拖鞋。
fullTextEN: because I like wearing vests and slippers the most.

fullTextZH: 在中国，如果你穿背心和拖鞋，
fullTextEN: In China, if you wear vests and slippers,

fullTextZH: 可能有的人觉得你有一点点邋遢。
fullTextEN: some people might think you look a bit sloppy.
But in Australia,
many people wear vests and slippers,
so it's no problem.
So, from December 2017 to now,

fullTextZH: 我已经在澳大利亚住了4年多了。
fullTextEN: I have already lived in Australia for over 4 years.

fullTextZH: 一开始我说我要去看看世界，
fullTextEN: At first, I said I wanted to see the world,

fullTextZH: 可是因为很多很多原因，
fullTextEN: but because of many reasons,
I have stayed in Australia.

fullTextZH: 最大的原因当然是因为疫情，
fullTextEN: The biggest reason is of course the pandemic,

fullTextZH: 但是在澳大利亚真的很舒服。
fullTextEN: But in Australia, it's really comfortable.

fullTextZH: 所以我不会很想很想去别的国家。
fullTextEN: So I don't really want to go to other countries.
So, Australia,
Thank you for your care!

fullTextZH: 你呢？你在外国生活过吗？
fullTextEN: What about you? Have you lived abroad?
If so,

fullTextZH: 那为什么你去了那个国家？
fullTextEN: Then why did you go to that country?
Leave a message and tell me!
Thank you, goodbye!
